columns.name: command
columns.description: The command path below the tool's name, such as `books show`, or the tool's name for its root command.

columns.name: runs
columns.description: The runs that did not print a help page.

columns.name: help_pages
columns.description: The runs that printed the command's help page.

columns.name: help_before
columns.description: The help pages that each run's session read since its last run that printed no help page, summed over the runs.

columns.name: failed
columns.description: The runs that failed.

columns.name: p50_out_bytes
columns.description: The median of the bytes that the runs wrote to standard output, by the nearest-rank method, or null when no run printed a result.

columns.name: p95_out_bytes
columns.description: The 95th percentile of the bytes that the runs wrote to standard output, or null when no run printed a result.

columns.name: refused
columns.description: The runs whose command line was refused.

columns.name: p50_ms
columns.description: The median of the runs' wall time in milliseconds, by the nearest-rank method, or null when every run printed help.

columns.name: p95_ms
columns.description: The 95th percentile of the runs' wall time in milliseconds, or null when every run printed help.

columns.name: cut_short
columns.description: The runs whose output a listing or stream cut short, because it showed fewer rows than its total or the output budget stopped it.

columns.name: typed_full
columns.description: The runs that typed `--full`.

columns.name: typed_all
columns.description: The runs that typed `--all`.

columns.name: typed_long
columns.description: The runs that typed `--long`.

data.about: Work with each run in shelf's usage log
List each run in shelf's usage log, grouped by session

arguments.name: --since
arguments.help: How far back to read the usage log, such as 12h, 7d or 2w

arguments.name: --log
arguments.help: Read this usage log instead of the tool's own

arguments.name: --exclude-program
arguments.help: Leave out the runs that a program with this name marked, such as flightdeck

arguments.name: --limit
arguments.help: Print at most this many rows

arguments.name: --all
arguments.help: Print every row

examples.about: Print each run of the last 7 days, grouped by session
Print every run of the last day

columns.name: session
columns.description: The run's session, numbered from 1 in the order of each session's first run in the listing's window.

columns.name: step
columns.description: The run's place in its session, from 1.

columns.name: command
columns.description: The command path below the tool's name, such as `books show`, or the tool's name for its root command.

columns.name: exit
columns.description: The run's exit code, or null when the run ended before it exited.

columns.name: code
columns.description: The code of the run's failure or refusal, such as `shelf::books::not_found`, or null when the run recorded none.

columns.name: ms
columns.description: The run's wall time in milliseconds.

columns.name: out_bytes
columns.description: The bytes that the run wrote to standard output, or null when the run did not reach `finish`.

columns.name: at
columns.description: When the run ended, in RFC 3339 to the second in UTC, such as `2026-10-11T11:56:40Z`.

columns.name: caller
columns.description: The coding agent's id, such as claude-code, person or unknown.

columns.name: flags
columns.description: The names of the flags that the caller typed, never their values.

columns.name: help
columns.description: Whether the run printed a help page.

columns.name: truncated
columns.description: Whether a listing or stream cut the run's output short.

columns.name: trace
columns.description: The id of the W3C trace that the run belongs to, as 32 lowercase hex digits.

columns.name: run
columns.description: The run's own span id, as 16 lowercase hex digits, which its child runs name as their parent.

columns.name: parent
columns.description: The span id of the run's caller, as 16 lowercase hex digits, or null when the run started a new trace.

data.about: Print the records of shelf's usage log after a run, oldest first

arguments.name: --after
arguments.help: Print only the records after the run with this span id, the `run` of the last record an earlier export printed

arguments.name: --log
arguments.help: Read this usage log instead of the tool's own

examples.about: Print every line of the usage log as JSON
Print the records after the last run that an earlier export printed

columns.name: gap
columns.description: Whether records may be missing before this one, because the run that `--after` named is no longer in the log, so the export printed every record the log holds. Only the first line of an export can be true.

columns.name: record
columns.description: The record with every field and value that the usage log stores, including the run's span id under `run`, which `--after` takes, and the keyed hashes of the run's session and command line.
